name: Vomia
description: Non-custodial DeFAI agent on Celo. Users log in with a social account (Web3Auth MPC), open a personal on-chain vault only they can withdraw from, and set a strategy: profit-gated FX rebalancing across Mento and Uniswap (measured against Mento's SortedOracles reference rate), or scheduled DCA into CELO and G$ — every trade capped by the vault's own on-chain per-trade and daily limits and tagged with an ERC-8021 attribution suffix. Paid x402 APIs available to other agents with no account or API key: fx-route returns the best cross-venue quote for a Celo stablecoin FX conversion, and check answers whether a pair is worth rebalancing right now.
